newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine trade secretary to visit Europe, Japan.
newsitem.headline: Argentine trade secretary to visit Europe, Japan.

text.p: Argentina's Trade and Industry Secretary Alieto Guadagni said Friday he will leave to Europe and Japan today to promote investment, particularly in Argentina's mining sector and airports.

"The objective of the meetings is to examine with European businesses and investors the perspectives for the Argentine economy, trade and the development of Mercosur in 1997," Guadagni told journalists.
Mercosur is a customs union between Brazil, Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay.

On November 11, Guadagni will take part in a seminar organized by Germany's Deutsche Bank and on November 12 and 13 he will meet with Belgian investors. After that he will talk to French businesses that already have interests in Argentina.
"Our idea is to clarify Argentina's perspectives and motivate investors for the pending privatizations, including the airports and hydro-electric power plants," said Guadagni.
In France, Guadagni will meet Industry Minister Yves Galland and the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD).
The Argentine official will travel to Japan after that where he will take part in a seminar on investment opportunities in mining on November 20.
